name: Brainrot Training
desc:
Welcome to Brainrot Training! Enter the world of racing and unlocking new brainrot characters like Tung Tung Sahur and Tralalero!
Reach the finish line in under 2 minutes and earn rewards!

🎁 Use Code "welcome" for free items!

🖱️ Train to gain race power!
⭐ Upgrade and rebirth to increase power!
🍲 Collect boosts from the world!
🖱️ Tap to grow stronger
👊CRAFT and upgrade equipment to gain boosts!
⭐COLLECT and discover 50+ Pets!
🌎 EXPLORE new worlds!

Battle enemies and click fast to gain power in this Brainrot Trainer which combines clicker, simulator, and race features!
Race the world and create your own Adventure while you get stronger!

Updates every week!

Premium players get +20% gems +10% luck!

👍 CODE AT 10000 LIKES!  ❤️❤️
